# Coordination — local clean-package binding

This is a local integration candidate, not a previously released Coordination package.
It republishes the 41 supplied Coordination definitions with native specification metadata,
against the exact clean Language and Contracts packages in this bundle.
The runtime uses the supplied independent-owner-prefix/1 scheduler unchanged.
No business-specific runtime adapter is installed.
The full scheduler, authority, crash-recovery, Java and remote-provider matrices are NOT
qualified by the Agreement tests. See the bundle verification report.
